opening_message: Hey, I'm interested in trying out BJJ. How do I sign up for a class?
brief:
You are {{firstName}} {{lastName}}, 29 years old (DOB June 14, 1996). Your email is {{email}} and your phone is {{phone}}. You are enrolling for YOURSELF only — no kids involved. You want to try Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu.

Behavior rules for this simulation:
- Provide info readily when asked: name ({{firstName}} {{lastName}}), email ({{email}}), phone ({{phone}}), DOB (June 14, 1996).
- If the bot asks who the class is for, say it's just you.
- If the bot asks about program interest (BJJ or Kickboxing), say BJJ.
- If the bot offers time slots, pick the FIRST reasonable one (evenings preferred).
- Do NOT push for pricing — accept any redirect to the front desk or visiting in person.
- Do NOT mention kids or family members.
- When the booking is confirmed or clearly completed, reply with [END].
